application_order: Start with the recorded revisions unpatched, then invoke harness/evaluate.sh with the candidate.
The evaluator applies integration_patch at the CVA6 repository root to defer same-cycle removal of a newly accepted LSU request
The evaluator integrates the submitted module and reverses its integration patches on exit. Do not apply these patches before invocation.
test_selection: Six RISC-V Architectural Tests maintained by the recorded test repository execute aligned byte, halfword, and word loads and stores through the complete CPU. The fixed integration patch retains each newly accepted request in the two-entry LSU bypass FIFO for one cycle. Internal FIFO state is not used for acceptance.
port_observation: With the pinned CV32A60X configuration and parent record types, check immediate complete-request delivery, same-cycle removal, held and already issued requests, removal in issue order, and readiness when empty.

reconstruction.test_sources: The ordered patch records describe test provenance. Start with the pinned test sources and leave these patches unapplied before invoking harness/evaluate.sh, which reconstructs the tests.
reconstruction.evaluation: Start from an unpatched checkout and invoke harness/evaluate.sh with the candidate; the evaluator applies its own patches and restores its inputs.
